title: contentDisposition parse rejects tab whitespace
prompt: contentDisposition.parse(string) in index.js only treats the space character as whitespace around the disposition type and around parameter names, '=' and values. Header values may use any linear whitespace, including a horizontal tab, e.g. 'attachment;	filename="x.txt"' or 'attachment	; filename	=	"x.txt"', and those are currently rejected or parsed wrongly. Please make parse accept tabs as well as spaces in those positions.
